notes: Trees behind the house, right behind the school in Colcord. Dead oak hangs over the carport — all work on the dead oak is done from a lift; no climbing on the dead tree. Prices include cutting, clean-up, and haul-off. Full options: dead oak removed by itself $2,250; second oak removed by itself $1,650; both removed $3,400 (this quote). Or reduce instead of remove: dead oak $950, second oak $600, both $1,400. Optional add-on: stump grinding $175 per stump (stumps are cut flush in the prices above).
